comments: I think you need to pass an actual selector to :global() - [REPL](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAACp1Sy27CMBD8FcvqAVoeoafKCaj9DszBcTbBwllH9oaCUP69SkJokKqq5WbP7Mysd33hubEQuNheOKoSuOAfVcVnnM5VewlHsAR8xoOrvW6RJGhvKtpIlGSBmHY1Eluzp0CKYBJNY4ktl9eoyThkBrWHEpAmU3ZpGUm95mXNVm0xNRKT5bctJpk5skyRmhceALuoDtNWhbCWPHUnyTfJMjPHjaRW3Z3upKmt4TFlVfvK_k8b6HxVLFJ3Gp75aTLaC7aKouoU99AeTLGnMdb043o_wDn3qoTAglYW5grN4JN7Vw5nSR0tWLR4u3o2IxtRWJcqO9l-j283ZeOmUqUPhXc1ZoJ1_NVFoSlVuzAxauA1MIO5QUMQ_5DyfNvo9jbz3V3afV7LxwPxp0DWjP37zfyW0Fc8ktF_wm6PfMZLl5ncQMYF-RqaXfMFhyj-RikDAAA=)

You need to prepend your keyframes with `-global-` if you want to makes them accessible globally. [Fixed example](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAACpVRQW7CMBD8imX1ACqB0FPlBNS-A3NwnA1YOOvI3lAQyt8rJ6QB9dLe1jOemfX4xitjIXCxu3FUNXDBP5uGLzhdm3gIZ7AEfMGDa72OSB60Nw1tJUqyQEy7Folt2EsgRTBL55nEyFUtajIOmUHtoQak2ZzdIiNp0Lxu2Dpepk5ivppsMS_NmZWKVHLwANhH9Zi2KoSN5IW7SL7NV6U5byVFdT89SQvbwr-Uga52UCwLdxlX_TIlHQVbp2lzyQboCOZwpEesG578cYJr5VUNgSUH6wplk6CVhUShGf0q7-pxltTTgqXL97t392AnBo_ZbqpiP2ePyxVKnw7etVgK1vN3F4WmVrF8waYF3gIzWBk0BNnvlNFy91Pe_inqOSzy2Uj8KY1100_3RfMFr11pKgMlF-Rb6PbdN84NmXqOAgAA).
[This is noted in the current docs aswell](https://svelte.dev/docs/svelte-components#style)

The first snippet is invalid, you probably mean `:global([data-blue]) { .. }` - and that's where the crucial difference is:
- `:global(...)` only makes the things within the parantheses global, not the things after it
- `:global` is making _everything_ below it global

Then I guess I found a [bug](https://svelte-5-preview.vercel.app/#H4sIAAAAAAAAE5VRy27CMBD8FcvqAVQeoafKCaj9DszBcTbBwllH9oaCUP69ckJKUC_tzZ7ZmVmPb7w0FgIX-xtHVQMX_LNp-ILTtYmXcAZLwBc8uNbriGRBe9PQTqIkC8S0a5HYlr0EUgSzZJ5KjFzZoibjkBnUHmpAms3ZLTKSBs3rlm3iMHUSs_XDFrPCnFmhSC0rD4B9VI9pq0LYSp67i-S7bF2Y805SVPenJ2luW_iXMtDVDopV7i7jql-moKNgmyRpLukAHcFUR5pi3fDkjxNcS69qCCxoZWGp0Iw-pXf1eJbU04Ilq_e7ZzexEZV1ubKz_aOCw5xNl8qVPlXetVgI1vN3F4WmVrF0MVngLTCDpUFDkP5OYfuftg6j_TTqOSyOpSPxpzTWPX64L5gveO0KUxoouCDfQnfovgEgF6UKhgIAAA==) because first snippet works and does not throw any errors.
